name: m7_kick
note: Automation file (rv_render --auto), not a sweep: sweeps cannot fire Kicks. Use with test_audio/stimulus/05_silence_for_kicks.wav and --set attitude=CLEAN|DRIVEN|KICKED. Single Kicks at 1, 6, 11 s; a pair 250 ms apart at 16 s; a 12/s gate train 20-22 s (24 Kicks); a last single at 27 s.
